questions.text: It is impossible to do this.
questions.textHindi: It is impossible to do this.

options.text: This is impossible to be done

options.textHindi: It is impossible to have done this

questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) This is impossible to be done (B) To do this by it is impossible (C) It is impossible to have done this (D) It can't be done
Correct Answer: (A) This is impossible to be done
The active infinitive "to do" converts to the passive infinitive "to be done".

questions.text: "Call the witness," said the judge.
questions.textHindi: "Call the witness," said the judge.

options.text: The judge commanded to call the witness
options.textHindi: The judge commanded to call the witness

options.text: The judge commanded them to call the witness

options.text: The judge commanded the witness to be called Correct
options.textHindi: The judge commanded the witness to be called Correct

Correct Answer: (D) The judge commanded the witness to be called
Direct imperative sentences with an object are converted into indirect speech using "commanded [object] to be [past participle]".

questions.text: The doctor advised him to rest for _____ days.
questions.textHindi: The doctor advised him to rest for _____ days.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) few (B) a few (C) a little (D) little
Correct Answer: (B) a few
'Days' is a plural countable noun, requiring the quantifier 'a few' (meaning a small number).

questions.text: A thorough search of the aircraft was carried _____ in the airport.
questions.textHindi: A thorough search of the aircraft was carried _____ in the airport.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) out (B) on (C) off (D) along
Correct Answer: (A) out
The phrasal verb 'carry out' means to conduct or perform a task or search.

questions.text: As she became tired, error began to creep _____ her work.
questions.textHindi: As she became tired, error began to creep _____ her work.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) with (B) off (C) into (D) up
Correct Answer: (C) into
'Creep into' means to gradually enter or infiltrate.

questions.text: Choose a one-word substitution for 'The absence of government in a country':
questions.textHindi: Choose a one-word substitution for 'The absence of government in a country':
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Ascetic (B) Amnesia (C) Aphasia (D) Anarchy
Correct Answer: (D) Anarchy
'Anarchy' refers to a state of disorder due to the absence of government or authority.

questions.text: She needs some new clothes, _____?
questions.textHindi: She needs some new clothes, _____?
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) need she (B) needn't she (C) does she (D) doesn't she
Correct Answer: (D) doesn't she
'Needs' acts as a main verb in the present simple affirmative, so the question tag is 'doesn't she'.

questions.text: The synonym of 'Marvellous' is
questions.textHindi: The synonym of 'Marvellous' is
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Wonderful (B) Simple (C) Ordinary (D) Attractive
Correct Answer: (A) Wonderful
'Marvellous' means extraordinary or wonderful.

questions.text: The antonym of 'Fixed' is
questions.textHindi: The antonym of 'Fixed' is
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Established (B) Confirmed (C) Undecided (D) Immobile
Correct Answer: (C) Undecided
'Fixed' implies settled or decided; its antonym among the options is 'Undecided'.

questions.text: The synonym of 'Hoard' is
questions.textHindi: The synonym of 'Hoard' is
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Destroy (B) Hide (C) Store (D) Divide
Correct Answer: (C) Store
To 'hoard' means to amass and store away goods or money.

questions.text: The antonym of 'Moisture' is
questions.textHindi: The antonym of 'Moisture' is
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Wetness (B) Dryness (C) Dampness (D) Roughness
Correct Answer: (B) Dryness
'Moisture' refers to wetness, and its exact antonym is 'Dryness'.

questions.text: Sumit asked her if she was ill.
questions.textHindi: Sumit asked her if she was ill.

options.textHindi: Sumit said to her, "Are you ill ?"

options.textHindi: Sumit said to her, "Is she ill?" Correct

Correct Answer: (C) Sumit said to her, "Are you ill ?"
The indirect question "if she was ill" in past tense converts back to direct present interrogative "Are you ill?".

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of 'Jealous':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct synonym of 'Jealous':
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Remorse (B) Envious (C) Regretful (D) Unhappy
Correct Answer: (B) Envious
'Envious' is the direct synonym of 'jealous'.

questions.text: The _____ duty of every citizen is to respect the country.
questions.textHindi: The _____ duty of every citizen is to respect the country.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) each and every (B) first and foremost (C) over and above (D) unless and until
Correct Answer: (B) first and foremost
'First and foremost' means most importantly or primarily.

questions.text: Make sure you _____ at least two hours before your flight.
questions.textHindi: Make sure you _____ at least two hours before your flight.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) check off (B) check up (C) check out (D) check in
Correct Answer: (D) check in
'Check in' is the standard phrasal verb for registering at an airport before a flight.

Correct Answer: (D) Sheetal ran fast to win the race
Combines past actions using an infinitive of purpose ("to win the race").

questions.text: He broke the lock _____ a hammer.
questions.textHindi: He broke the lock _____ a hammer.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) without hail (B) with the help of (C) with a vengeance (D) with an eye to
Correct Answer: (B) with the help of
'With the help of' indicates the tool or instrument used.

questions.text: Abriti has decided _____ more.
questions.textHindi: Abriti has decided _____ more.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) to earned (B) will earn (C) to earning (D) to earn
Correct Answer: (D) to earn
The verb 'decide' is followed by the to-infinitive ("to earn").

Correct Answer: (A) He said to me, "Please keep the door open."
The reporting verb "requested" translates to "Please" in direct speech.

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.textHindi: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Jandice (B) Jandece (C) Jaundice (D) Jaundece
Correct Answer: (C) Jaundice
'Jaundice' is the correct spelling.

questions.text: India will win the world cup. That is certain.
questions.textHindi: India will win the world cup. That is certain.

options.textHindi: India will win the world cup certainly Correct

Correct Answer: (B) India will certainly win the world cup
The adverb 'certainly' neatly modifies the verb phrase to combine certainty into a single sentence.

Correct Answer: (B) The boys run fast in the race

questions.text: I got late for the flight _____ there was so much traffic on the road.
questions.textHindi: I got late for the flight _____ there was so much traffic on the road.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) because (B) until (C) more (D) after
Correct Answer: (A) because
'Because' is a subordinating conjunction indicating cause and effect.

questions.text: We located the key _____ the lock.
questions.textHindi: We located the key _____ the lock.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) during (B) since (C) unless (D) for
Correct Answer: (D) for (or contextual preposition linking key to lock).
Indicates purpose or association.

questions.text: Sunaina loves _____ to music.
questions.textHindi: Sunaina loves _____ to music.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) listening (B) listens (C) to listen (D) listen
Correct Answer: (A) listening (or C)
Both gerund and infinitive are grammatically acceptable after 'love', with 'listening' being very common.

questions.text: There _____ an armchair in my bedroom.
questions.textHindi: There _____ an armchair in my bedroom.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) any (B) are (C) is (D) some
Correct Answer: (C) is
'An armchair' is singular, so it requires the singular verb 'is'.

questions.text: The boys _____ very tired today because they were at a party last night.
questions.textHindi: The boys _____ very tired today because they were at a party last night.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) is (B) were (C) was (D) are
Correct Answer: (D) are (or were)
Present state "today" takes 'are'.

Correct Answer: (B) Rohini said that she had got a stomach-ache.
Past reporting verb shifts present 'have' to past 'had got'.

questions.text: The meeting _____ at half-past eight.
questions.textHindi: The meeting _____ at half-past eight.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) starts (B) starting (C) start (D) will be started
Correct Answer: (A) starts
Timetabled or scheduled events in the present use the simple present tense.

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of - 'Docile':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of - 'Docile':
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Very bad (B) Obedient (C) Respect (D) Disfigure
Correct Answer: (B) Obedient
'Docile' means submissive, compliant, or obedient.

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of - "To keep one's temper":
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of - "To keep one's temper":
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) To become hungry (B) To be aloof (C) To remain calm (D) To preserve one's energy
Correct Answer: (C) To remain calm
To keep one's temper means to stay calm and control one's anger.

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of - "To cry wolf":
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of - "To cry wolf":

options.text: To give a false alarm Correct
options.textHindi: To give a false alarm Correct

questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) To listen eagerly (B) To turn pale (C) To be hungry (D) To give a false alarm
Correct Answer: (D) To give a false alarm
'To cry wolf' means to raise a false alarm, causing people to ignore real danger.

questions.text: They decided to _____ his number in the yellow pages.
questions.textHindi: They decided to _____ his number in the yellow pages.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) look into (B) look up (C) look at (D) look onto
Correct Answer: (B) look up
'Look up' means to search for information in a reference book or directory.

questions.text: After a prolonged suffering he 'passed away'.
questions.textHindi: After a prolonged suffering he 'passed away'.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) went away (B) expired (C) left (D) yielded
Correct Answer: (B) expired
'Passed away' is a polite synonym for dying/expiring.

questions.text: We have no alternative plan to _____ on.
questions.textHindi: We have no alternative plan to _____ on.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) fall back (B) fall for (C) fall out (D) fall off
Correct Answer: (A) fall back
'Fall back on' means to use as a reserve or alternative.

questions.text: She came across some papers she was looking for.
questions.textHindi: She came across some papers she was looking for.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) saw from a distance (B) touched (C) found unexpectedly (D) read quickly
Correct Answer: (C) found unexpectedly
'Come across' means to discover by chance.

questions.text: You need to buy _____ refrigerator.
questions.textHindi: You need to buy _____ refrigerator.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) a (B) the (C) an (D) no article
Correct Answer: (A) a
'Refrigerator' is a singular countable noun beginning with a consonant sound.

questions.text: We saw a _____ of lions at the sanctuary.
questions.textHindi: We saw a _____ of lions at the sanctuary.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) herd (B) flock (C) pride (D) bunch
Correct Answer: (C) pride
A collective noun for lions is a 'pride'.

questions.text: Choose the odd one out:
questions.textHindi: Choose the odd one out:
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Wheat (B) Paddy (C) Barley (D) Mustard
Correct Answer: (D) Mustard
Wheat, paddy, and barley are cereal crops, whereas mustard is an oilseed.

questions.text: I like the books _____ have interesting stories.
questions.textHindi: I like the books _____ have interesting stories.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) who (B) that (C) whom (D) what
Correct Answer: (B) that
'That' serves as the relative pronoun for inanimate objects/books.

questions.text: I have no _____ to you going for a movie.
questions.textHindi: I have no _____ to you going for a movie.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) object (B) objecting (C) objection (D) objective
Correct Answer: (C) objection
The noun 'objection' follows the determiner 'no'.

questions.text: You _____ cross the road when the traffic light is red.
questions.textHindi: You _____ cross the road when the traffic light is red.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) have to (B) must (C) musn't (D) had to
Correct Answer: (C) musn't (must not)
Red traffic light prohibits crossing, expressed by 'mustn't'.

questions.text: Ankita _____ come yet; the whole class is waiting for her.
questions.textHindi: Ankita _____ come yet; the whole class is waiting for her.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) hadn't (B) haven't (C) hasn't (D) didn't
Correct Answer: (C) hasn't
Present perfect tense with 'yet' for singular subject takes 'hasn't'.

Correct Answer: (C) A get-together party should be organised
Suggestions with "Let us" convert to passive using "should be [past participle]".

questions.text: Milan is _____ Italian city.
questions.textHindi: Milan is _____ Italian city.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) a (B) the (C) an (D) no article
Correct Answer: (C) an
'Italian' begins with a vowel sound, taking the article 'an'.

questions.text: Rolls-Royce cars are _____
questions.textHindi: Rolls-Royce cars are _____
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) cheap (B) expensive (C) blue (D) tall
Correct Answer: (B) expensive
Rolls-Royce automobiles are renowned luxury vehicles.

questions.text: _____ languages does Aryan speak?
questions.textHindi: _____ languages does Aryan speak?
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) How (B) How many (C) How much (D) Where
Correct Answer: (B) How many
Languages are countable nouns, requiring 'How many'.

questions.text: That's my book. Can I have _____ back please?
questions.textHindi: That's my book. Can I have _____ back please?
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) it (B) them (C) you (D) my
Correct Answer: (A) it
'Book' is a singular neuter noun referred to by the pronoun 'it'.

questions.text: Choose a one-word substitution for 'Ceremony of crowning a king':
questions.textHindi: Choose a one-word substitution for 'Ceremony of crowning a king':
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Contagious (B) Coronation (C) Dexterous (D) Denizen
Correct Answer: (B) Coronation
'Coronation' is the crowning ceremony of a monarch.

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of "Blow one's own trumpet":
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of "Blow one's own trumpet":
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Entirely (B) Ready to obey order (C) To praise oneself (D) With all belongings

To blow one's own trumpet means to boast.

questions.text: The two friends had a _____ talk after a long time.
questions.textHindi: The two friends had a _____ talk after a long time.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) hold good (B) heart to heart (C) in no time (D) in the air
Correct Answer: (B) heart to heart
'Heart to heart' denotes a frank, intimate conversation.

questions.text: Choose the correct antonym of 'Humility':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct antonym of 'Humility':
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Dignity (B) Anger (C) Cruelty (D) Pride
Correct Answer: (D) Pride
'Humility' means modesty; its direct antonym is 'Pride'.

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of 'Relish':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct synonym of 'Relish':
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Realize (B) Enjoy (C) Taste (D) Reveal
Correct Answer: (B) Enjoy
To 'relish' means to enjoy greatly.

questions.text: Choose the correct antonym of 'Scorn':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct antonym of 'Scorn':
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Joy (B) Admiration (C) Contempt (D) Pity
Correct Answer: (B) Admiration
'Scorn' means contempt; its antonym is 'Admiration'.

questions.text: _____ have that dress specially made?
questions.textHindi: _____ have that dress specially made?
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) Has you (B) Could you (C) Should you (D) Did you have
Correct Answer: (D) Did you have
Past causative interrogative structure.

questions.text: Learning _____ is not easy.
questions.textHindi: Learning _____ is not easy.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) for Sanskrit (B) Sanskrit (C) the Sanskrit (D) of Sanskrit
Correct Answer: (B) Sanskrit
Academic subjects/languages do not take articles when used as direct objects or subjects.

questions.text: I saw two crows _____ poking their heads at the flowerpot.
questions.textHindi: I saw two crows _____ poking their heads at the flowerpot.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) play (B) played (C) playing (D) playfully
Correct Answer: (C) playing
Present participle indicates an action in progress witnessed by the speaker.

questions.text: Please have _____ more rice, you haven't taken much.
questions.textHindi: Please have _____ more rice, you haven't taken much.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) some (B) any (C) no (D) several
Correct Answer: (A) some
'Some' is used in polite offers and requests.

questions.text: Work _____ to score good marks.
questions.textHindi: Work _____ to score good marks.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) so hard (B) hard (C) much hard (D) hardly
Correct Answer: (B) hard
'Work hard' is the correct adverbial collocation.

questions.text: Someone was knocking _____ the door.
questions.textHindi: Someone was knocking _____ the door.
questions.explanationHindi:
Options: (A) by (B) to (C) since (D) at
Correct Answer: (D) at
The preposition 'at' is used with knocking on doors.

Correct Answer: (D) window to the world

questions.text:
Answer any five of the following in about 40-50 words each:
Options/Questions:
a) What did Benjy want to do with money?
b) Why were the intellectuals in India restless and embittered ?
c) Why does Lomov think that his is a critical age ?
d) What are Pearl S. Buck's views on the Christian missionaries ?
e) What does the poet think about 'beauty'?
f) In what way will the travellers be blessed ?
g) If at all he dies in the battle, how would the soldier like to be remembered ?
h) What has formed the speaker's blood ?
i) What are the dramatic structures of a tragedy ?
j) Which period is characterised by inflections ?
Answers (for all 5 questions chosen from a-j):
- a) Benjy wanted to deposit his accumulated savings from his egg-farming business into a bank account to buy more land from his neighbor, Mr. Sanders.
- b) Intellectuals in India were restless and embittered because under British rule, they faced unemployment, lack of industrial opportunities, and restrictions on national progress.
- c) Lomov thinks his age (35) is critical because he suffers from palpitations, sleep disturbances, and physical weakness, making it imperative for him to settle down and marry without delay.
- d) Pearl S. Buck viewed early Western Christian missionaries with mixed feelings; while acknowledging their dedication, she noted their cultural detachment and sometimes patronizing attitudes towards local traditions.
- e) In "An Epitaph", Walter de la Mare notes that physical beauty is fleeting, perishable, and temporary, whereas inner truth and character endure.
- f) In "Now the Leaves are Falling Fast", the travellers (representing human souls) will be blessed by angels who restore their hope and guide them through death to eternal peace.
- g) If he dies in battle, the soldier wishes to be remembered as someone whose resting place forever enriches a foreign field with a piece of English dust—representing England's memory, thoughts, and dreams.
- h) In "Song of Myself", Walt Whitman states that his blood is formed from the soil and air of his native land, connecting him universally with nature and humanity.
- i) The dramatic structures of a tragedy typically follow Freytag's pyramid: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, and catastrophic resolution.
- j) The Old English period is characterized by inflections (grammatical endings for gender, case, and number).

Passage Summary: Student life is the golden age because character is formed, free from human suffering and burdens, allowing full enjoyment.
Questions & Answers:
a) Why is student life important?
Answer: Student life is important because a person's future and character are formed during this time.
b) Why is student life called 'the golden age'?
Answer: It is called the golden age because students enjoy life to the fullest without the burdens of human suffering.
c) What does a person enjoy during student life?
Answer: A person enjoys student life to the fullest.
d) How does he enjoy life to the fullest?
Answer: He enjoys life fully because there is no burden of human suffering or heavy responsibilities during this phase.
